newsitem.title: INDIA: India 1995/96 domestic savings rate down - RBI.
newsitem.headline: India 1995/96 domestic savings rate down - RBI.

text.p: Available information indicated that the rate of Indian household savings has fallen, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said in its 1995/96 (July-June) annual report released on Friday.
The gross domestic saving rate improved from 21.4 percent in 1993/94 (April-March) to 24.4 percent in 1994/95, it said.

"Savings estimates are not yet available for 1995/96. Available information on household savings in financial assets however suggests that the rate has moderated to 9.1 percent of GDP (gross domestic product), largely owing to lower increase in households' holdings of bank deposits, shares and debentures and small savings," the report said.
